Act6-3#1.zh: 林教头，太尉在门内等你，请进。
Act6-3#1.t: Instructor Lin, the Marshal awaits you inside. Please enter.

Act6-3#2.zh: 来者何人？！竟敢擅闯白虎节堂！
Act6-3#2.t: Who goes there?! How dare you barge into White Tiger Hall!

Act6-3#4.zh: 王潮、马瀚，给我把这名刺客捉起来！
Act6-3#4.t: Wang Chao, Ma Han, seize this assassin!

Act6-3#5.zh: 太尉！这是误会！是我林冲啊！
Act6-3#5.t: Marshal! This is a misunderstanding! It's me, Lin Chong!

Act6-3#6.zh: 哦，的确是林冲...你身为朝廷命官，更应该知道白虎节堂是什么去处...
Act6-3#6.t: Oh, it is Lin Chong... As an officer of the court, you should know exactly what White Tiger Hall is...

Act6-3#7.zh: (不好！白虎节堂是商议军事机密的地方，如果没有许可是不能随便擅闯的...)
Act6-3#7.t: (Oh no! White Tiger Hall is where military secrets are discussed. No one may enter without permission...)

Act6-3#8.zh: 林冲！你无本人呼唤，居然敢擅闯白虎节堂！你可知法律吗？！你是想要行刺本官，还是想偷窃国家机密？！
Act6-3#8.t: Lin Chong! Without my summons, you dared to barge into White Tiger Hall! Do you know the law?! Did you come to assassinate me, or to steal state secrets?!

Act6-3#9.zh: 太尉！明明是你叫人送信，打算设酒席排解纠纷才叫我来的啊！
Act6-3#9.t: Marshal! You sent me a letter yourself, saying you'd set a banquet to settle our quarrel. That's why I came!

Act6-3#10.zh: 哼！别以为你在干什么我不知道！想必你是想对本官不利！否则你为何与弃职逃官的王进相互勾结？！王进写给你的信我都已经看过了！
Act6-3#10.t: Hmph! Don't think I don't know what you're up to! You must mean me harm! Otherwise why are you in league with Wang Jin, who deserted his post? I've already read the letter Wang Jin wrote you!

Act6-3#11.t: (What! How did he get that letter!)

Act6-3#12.zh: 王进那厮仗着老子的势，看不起本官；甚至装病不屑见本官！再者弃职逃官躲到延安府，最后竟然勾结我管辖军官打算行刺我！你这个吃里扒外的家伙！我不打死你也要把你刺配边疆！
Act6-3#12.t: That Wang Jin relied on his father's standing and looked down on me, even faking illness rather than see me! Then he deserted his post and hid in Yan'an, and now he's conspiring with an officer under my command to assassinate me! You traitor! If I don't beat you to death, I'll have you exiled to the frontier!

Act6-3#13.zh: 冤枉啊！太尉，我从来没有想要行刺你啊！
Act6-3#13.t: I've been wronged! Marshal, I never meant to assassinate you!

Act6-3#14.zh: 还敢狡辩？！除了物证以外，我连人证都有了！
Act6-3#14.t: Still arguing?! Besides the evidence, I have a witness too!

Act6-3#15.zh: 嘿嘿嘿...这封信千真万确是从你身上掉下来的，林教头...
Act6-3#15.t: Heh heh heh... this letter really did fall out of your pocket, Instructor Lin...

Act6-3#16.zh: 林冲！现在人证、物证皆齐全，你还有什么话要讲！
Act6-3#16.t: Lin Chong! Witness and evidence are both here. What more do you have to say!

Act6-3#17.zh: 哈哈哈...原来是这样子啊！太尉为子报仇，太感人了！太感人了！
Act6-3#17.t: Hahaha... so that's it! The Marshal avenging his son, how touching! How touching!

Act6-3#18.zh: 林冲！你犯下这种叛逆之罪，还不快点伏首认罪？！
Act6-3#18.t: Lin Chong! You've committed treason. Bow your head and confess!

Act6-3#19.zh: 我已经知道剧本是怎么写的...剧本最后不是我死在大牢，就是在押解途中被人害死吧...很可惜，我不会照着你们的剧本演！
Act6-3#19.t: I know how this script is written... It ends with me dying in prison, or being murdered on the road into exile... Too bad. I won't play by your script!

Act6-3#20.zh: 高俅！我会用这个拳头打断你那高傲的鼻子！
Act6-3#20.t: Gao Qiu! I'll break that proud nose of yours with this fist!

Act6-3#21.t: '%M' %N is here! Instructor Lin, we've come to save you!

Act6-3#22.zh: 『九纹龙』史进在此！不怕死的就过来吧！
Act6-3#22.t: 'Nine Dragons' Shi Jin is here! Come on if you're not afraid to die!

Act6-3#23.zh: 俺就是『花和尚』鲁智深！让你们尝尝俺拳头的厉害！
Act6-3#23.t: I'm the 'Tattooed Monk' Lu Zhishen! Have a taste of my fists!

Act6-3#27.zh: 少华山三头目来当你们的对手！
Act6-3#27.t: The three chiefs of Mount Shaohua will be your opponents!

Act6-3#28.zh: 反了！反了！强盗居然打进太尉府中！每个反贼都不要给我放走！对了，林教头，只要捉住这些强盗，你的罪就一笔勾销！
Act6-3#28.t: Rebellion! Rebellion! Bandits breaking into the Marshal's manor! Let none of these rebels escape! Oh, and Instructor Lin, capture these bandits and your crime will be wiped clean!

Act6-3#29.zh: 哼...八十万禁军教头林冲在刚才已经死了...这些是我的同伴，我是『豹子头』林冲！
Act6-3#29.t: Hmph... Lin Chong, instructor of the eight hundred thousand Imperial Guards, died just now... These are my companions. I am 'Panther Head' Lin Chong!

Act6-3#30.zh: 『豹子头』林冲，从此踏上漫漫的不归路。
Act6-3#30.t: 'Panther Head' Lin Chong sets out on the long road of no return.
